description: Target manifest for Spatial, Compound and Common-Mode Reliability Specialist, covering network error propagation, spatial calibration, 2D risk surfaces, compound hazard sets, and common-mode failure indicators.

invariants.non_causal_propagation: Propagation models empirical spatio-temporal covariance of forecast errors, never physical causality.
invariants.anti_leakage: All network features constrained to issue time t0. Station ground truth sealed behind 24h verification latency.
invariants.no_probability_averaging: Compound hazard probabilities must be evaluated as explicit joint sets with copula bounds, never averaged into an unexplained composite.
invariants.rainfall_distinct_from_flood: Precipitation forecast failure reliability is strictly distinct from hydrological flood probability.
invariants.unseen_region_generalization: Leave-one-region-out (LORO) hold-out validation required for all spatial models.

targets.name: Lagged Spatial Error Covariance Exceedance
targets.description: Empirical lagged error covariance between upstream and downstream network nodes exceeding r=0.40 at 24h lead lag.

targets.name: Regional Cluster Calibration Miscoverage
targets.description: Maximum expected calibration error (ECE) across all 7 regional macro-clusters constrained below 0.12.

targets.name: Continuous Spatial Risk Surface Interpolation Error
targets.description: Brier score of interpolated continuous 2D spatial failure probability surface evaluated against gridded verification.

targets.name: Compound Extreme Heat and Severe Convective Wind Failure
targets.description: Concurrent failure on both extreme maximum temperature (Tmax >= 40°C) and severe wind gale gust (V >= 17.2 m/s).

targets.name: Compound Heavy Rain and Gale Gust Failure
targets.description: Concurrent failure on heavy precipitation (P >= 64.5 mm) and severe wind gust (V >= 17.2 m/s). Strictly decoupled from flood claims.

targets.name: Multi-Station Synoptic Phase Lock Failure
targets.description: Systemic NWP failure occurring simultaneously across >= 5 stations within the same synoptic corridor.
